tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per the remaining conditions and documents stipulated in the Bid Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 0.14 lakhs Credit lines Letters of Credit Certificates from any Nationalized Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc Usually 30percent of the amount of contract un conditional Line of Credit allowed Conditional Line of Credit not allowed
Section XII performa should be enclosed.
Section XIV Proforma should be enclosed
Tender form VIII should be enclosed

Tenderer offering to supply goods under the contract which the Tenderer did not manufacture of otherwise produce, the Tenderer has been duly authorized as per authorization form in Section XIII by the goods manufacturer or produce to supply the goods in India
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance in proforma under Section XII Rs.0.22lakh

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last 5 years 2021-22 to 2025-2026 achieved in at least two financial years continuous period of 12 months a minimum financial turnover of of Rs.0.45 lakhs As documentary evidence the tenderer should furnish copies of Audited Balance Sheet with profit & loss account with UDIN no duly certified by The Chartered Account
